༄༅/dgongs gter sgrol ma'i zab tig las/maṇḍal cho ga tshogs gnyis snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ dgongs gter sgrol ma'i zab tig las/ maṇḍal cho ga tshogs gnyis snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru ārya tā ra ye/ dus gsum 'dren pa sras bcas las// thugs bskyed phrin las rmad byung ba// yum gyur sgrol ma la btud nas// bya spyod dang mthun nyams len bshad// de'ang zab tig 'di rnams yang zab snying po bsdus pa yin pas spros bcas mang du mi dgos kyang*/ cung zad spros pa dang*/ rgyun khyer du bya ba ste rgyas bsdus gnyis las| dang po ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku brnyan bris 'bur sogs dkon mchog gi rten gang 'dzom mdun du stegs bu gtsang mar chu gnyis nyer spyod/ dkar zlum/ bsang chu/ mchod pa'i maṇḍal/ 'thor nas sogs 'du byas/ 'grub na khrus dang gtsang sbra'i kun spyod dang ldan pa bya zhing*/ mi lcogs na sha chang ma 'thung ba'i snga dro'i cha lta bur srid las nges 'byung dang*/ byang chub sems kyi kun slong dang ldan pas skyabs sems ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun ma mngon sum du bzhugs par mos la/ na mo/ dkon mchog kun dngos rje btsun mar// bdag sogs 'gro kun skyabs su mchi// byang chub smon pa'i sems bskyed nas// zab mo'i lam la 'jug par bgyi// tshogs bsags pa ni/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*// sogs nas/ 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /ces pa'i bar brjod/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ gnas yul padmo bkod pa'i zhing*// dbyibs dang rgyan bkod tshad med par// lha rdzas ting 'dzin las grub pa'i// mchod rdzas bsam mi khyab par gyur// oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ: de nas thog mar dkon mchog spyi la phyag mchod 'bul ba ni/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/

yan lag bdun pa ni/ ji snyed su dag nas/ phyir bsngo'o'i bar brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can gyi: lus dang longs spyod dge tshogs kun: gling bzhi ri rab nyi zlar bcas: lha mi'i longs spyod bsam mi khyab: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung che: rgyun mi 'chad par sprul byas te: dkon mchog rin chen rtsa ba gsum: chos srung nor lha rgya mtsho la: gus pas rtag tu 'bul bar bgyi: bsod nams tshogs chen rab rdzogs nas: ye shes snang ba rgyas par shog: oṃ gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī sarba ratna maṇḍa la pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: zhes maṇḍal phul/ na mo: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : chos srung nor lha gter gyi bdag: ye shes gcig gi ngo bo las: rang bzhin ma 'gag cir yang ston: thugs rje phrin las rmad po che: 'gro kun skyabs dang mgon gyur pa: mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid khyed rnams la: phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi: lus dang longs spyod mchod par 'bul: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams: rtag tu thugs rjes bskyab mdzad gsol: nad dang gnod pa zhi ba dang : tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang : bsam pa'i don rnams ma lus kun: chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zhes 'dod don gsol/ de nas bye brag rje btsun ma la mchod pa lan gsum 'bul zhing bstod pa'i rgyud 'don pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: rje btsun 'phags ma'i skur gsal ba'i: thugs kar zla steng tām̐ ljang gu: de las 'od zer dpag yas 'phros: 'phags ma rnam 'phrul nyer gcig dang : dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i sprin 'phro ba: mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs gyur: tām̐: skye med 'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings: 'gag med 'phags ma'i ye shes sku: gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul drwa bar shar: tshur gshegs ārya tā re dza: bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir: nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni:

ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid pa: de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol: padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ: oṃ: dngos 'byor yid las byung ba yi: kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyis: chos dbyings rgyas par bkang byas te: 'phags ma sgrol ma 'khor bcas mchod: oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā: zhes spyan drangs shing mchod pa spyir 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: khams gsum snod bcud dpal 'byor dang : bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs kun: thugs rje'i bdag nyid rnams la 'bul: bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ratna maṇḍa la pū dza hoḥzhes maṇḍal bye brag tu phul nas/ bstod pa'i rgyal po'i rgyud phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar gnyis brjod/ oṃ: dngos 'byor yid las sogs mchod pa/ maṇḍal gong ltar phul nas/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgya nyid: skyabs sbyin phyag rgyar gyur pa'i 'og: bdag dang bsrung bya kun tshud nas: 'jigs pa kun las dbugs dbyung gyur: ces mos la phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar gsum brjod/ yang mchod pa dang maṇḍal phul/ sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs: rang dang bsrung bya'i spyi bo nas: zhugs te lus kun gang ba yis: byin rlabs ma lus zhugs par gyur: ces mos la phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar bdun phan yon bcas brjod/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhwa bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ yig las: rin chen snod mchog yangs pa'i nang : 'bru gsum las byung gtor ma ni: zag med ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtso mo dang : ā ka ro lan gsum gyi mgron rnams la phul/ oṃ: mchod sbyin gtor ma dam pa 'di: ye shes chen pos rjes dgongs la: bde ba chen por bzhes nas kyang : dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol: zhes 'dod don gsol:

oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃḥ snang ba mtha' yas padma'i rigs: 'jig rten dbang phyug zhal las byung : sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las bdag: 'phags ma sgrol mar phyag 'tshal bstod: bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ thal mo sbyar la/ rje btsun 'phags ma 'khor dang bcas// dmigs med thugs rjes brtser dgongs la// bdag gis ji ltar gsol ba'i don// gegs med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas// bstan 'dzin thugs mthun zhabs pad brtan// nyer 'tshe'i bar chad kun zhi zhing*// bshad sgrub phrin las 'phel bar mdzod// nad mug 'khrugs rtsod zhi ba dang*// chos ldan dpal 'byor gong du 'phel// chos skyong rgyal po'i mnga' thang rgyas// rgyal khams mtha' dbus bde bar mdzod// 'jigs pa bcu drug dus min 'chi// rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa dang*// 'khor ba ngan song sdug bsngal sogs// gnas skabs mthar thug 'jigs las skyobs// tshe bsod dbang thang nyams rtogs 'phel// mi dge'i rtog pa mi 'byung zhing*// byang chub sems gnyis rtsol med skyes// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod// 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// bu gcig po la ma bzhin du// 'bral med thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// nyid dang dbyer med mdzad du gsol// zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba khyad par du btab cing thugs dam bskul bas/ mdun bskyed 'od zhu rang la thim: dbyer med nyid du byin brlabs pas: rang nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku: snang la rang bzhin med par gyur: ces rang nyid 'phags ma'i gsal snang dang nga rgyal la sems bzung ste yi ge bcu pa'i bzlas pa ci 'grub mthar/ yig brgya dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang sogs brjod la nongs pa bshags/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang*/ badzra muḥbarjod la mgron thabs kyi lha rnams gshegs/ lha dang rang sems dbyer med pa:

chos dbyings gnyug ma'i ngang du bzhag: ces gnas lugs kyi lta ba bskyang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag: 'phags ma sgrol ma sogs bsngo smon bya/ yid bzhin nor dang bum pa bzang po ltar// bsam pa'i don kun thogs med stsol mdzad pa// rje btsun sgrol ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyis// mi 'bral thugs rjes skyong ba'i bkra shis shog /ces sogs shis pa brjod la me tog 'thor ro// gnyis pa rgyun khyer bya ba'i tshe/ 'phags ma'i rten 'dzom na legs/ ma 'dzom na yid kyis bsgom pas 'thus/ maṇḍal dang mchod pa bshams la gong du smos pa'i/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs nas skyabs sems dang mchod pa byin rlabs btang*/ dkon mchog spyi mchod mi dgos pas/ rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: rje btsun 'phags ma'i skur gsal ba'i: sogs nas/ mchod pa maṇḍal bstod pa lan gsum bskyar ba'i phyi ma phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar bdun phan yon dang bcas pa'i mthar/ spro na/ rje btsun 'phags ma 'khor dang bcas/ sogs 'dod gsol 'grub na bya/ ma byas kyang chog /mdun bskyed 'od zhu sogs nas bzlas pa/ nongs bshags bar sngar ltar la/ gshegs gsol mi dgos/ lha dang rang sems sogs dang*/ dge bsngo shis brjod bcas kyis 'grub bo/// /
